mapper.select: select w.*, s.dept_name, s.parent_id from walk_dept w left join sys_dept s on w.dept_id = s.dept_id where w.dept_id = #{deptId}

select w.*, s.dept_name, s.parent_id from walk_dept w left join sys_dept s on w.dept_id = s.dept_id where w.dept_id in
#{id}

select w.*, s.dept_name, s.parent_id from walk_dept w left join sys_dept s on w.dept_id = s.dept_id
1=1 and w.org_level = #{orgLevel} and s.dept_name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%')
order by s.parent_id, w.org_level, w.dept_id

select s.dept_id, s.dept_name, s.parent_id from sys_dept s where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.dept_id not in (select dept_id from walk_dept)
and s.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
order by s.parent_id, s.order_num limit 50
